No bug found. _start returns a flat array of length 2n in both branches. For n=32 the symmetric branch makes 16 points and their reflections through (0.5, 0.5). The odd-n centre point is never used here. Points stay within [INIT_LOW, 1-INIT_LOW], the same range as the uniform branch. The starts only seed _relax, and the later steps still guarantee a valid packing.

Only one candidate run, so the evidence is weak. The incumbent mean (-2.9370) is already at the best published value (about 2.9370), so it may be partly lucky noise. Rejecting is consistent with the numbers, but the gap is well inside the noise.
